title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Chozhan labels Chandayatha a drama queen, but Nila defends her. Pandian apologises to Aravind and Vannathi while Pallavan hesitates entering as Cheran feeds Chandayatha.

title: Azhagae Azhagu
description: Bagyaraj blames Malar for the chaos. Meanwhile, a drunk Thangaraj questions Revathi on her lack of care for him, as Revathi and Mathi check on Malar and her mother.

title: Chinna Marumagal
description: Severe eye stinging troubles Vellathai and villagers after receiving drops at the free camp. Unaware of the deadly consequences, Sethupathi takes pride in arranging it.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: Shyam's confession and wish to marry Madhu leave her shocked and deeply disturbed. Kasthuri cares for ill Saranya, who refuses a hospital visit despite her persistent fever.

title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: Rajasekar's family leaves for their village to celebrate his 60th wedding anniversary. The couples create joyful memories along the way with songs and video recordings.

title: Onna Irukka Kaththukanum
description: Indhira sneaks away for the delivery job with Lakshmi's permission. Azhagappan probes Abhi about Shanmugam, prompting her to admit her love and reveal his rich background.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Pandian threatens suicide if Saravanan refuses to leave Anjali and return home. Anjali is devastated when Saravanan leaves with Pandian, causing their marriage to be called off.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Muthu and Meena turn barren land fertile and host a feast for villagers before leaving town. Selvam reveals Ragu's business competition, prompting Muthu to find a way to tackle it.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: Vetri exposes Abinaya's job lie, prompting Shanmugam to ask her to stay in the village. Meanwhile, Sudar helps Vetri learn and urges him to speak politely to Abinaya.

title: Thaai Maaman
description: Azhagar plans an alcohol treat for Sudalai with his friends. Suruli and Suna Pana prepare a suspicious drink to trick Sudalai, while Azhagar claims it is imported alcohol.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: Ilamathi gets furious when Kalamma humiliates Ganthimathi and vows to leave with her parents. Seeing through Kalamma's scheme, Paraman decides to join them, foiling her plot.
